description.value: The Spud Shack Fry Co. is a Belgian-inspired frite and poutine counter tucked into the New Westminster SkyTrain station above Safeway, making it one of the more transit-accessible food stops in the Lower Mainland. The menu leans into creative poutines — from smoked meat to butter chicken to a full vegetarian chili version — alongside handmade burgers and a rotating selection of craft beers and sodas. It's a no-fuss, satisfying refuel spot with a distinctly local character.
